research_findings: Discovered an incomplete rate-limiting implementation stub in `src/app/actions/waitlist.ts`.
Identified that the project environment checking script (`scripts/check-env.ts`) lacked validations for Upstash Redis configuration.
Verified that Upstash Redis is the chosen rate-limiting tool in this tech stack, but dependencies were missing from package.json.
features_improved: Improved environment variable validation by adding Upstash-related checks (`UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL` and `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN`) to `scripts/check-env.ts`.
Fixed an existing ESLint issue regarding React `useRef` rendering violations in `AdaptiveCoachDemo.tsx` that was causing `pnpm build` failures.
new_features_added: Added `@upstash/ratelimit` and `@upstash/redis` packages to support distributed rate limiting.
Implemented a reusable `rateLimit` utility in `src/lib/ratelimit.ts` which conditionally initializes to avoid build-time errors when environment variables are missing.
Integrated IP-based rate-limiting into the `joinWaitlist` server action (`src/app/actions/waitlist.ts`) to prevent abuse and heavy traffic.
next_steps_for_next_run: Integrate rate-limiting into other public-facing or heavily-used server actions, especially those related to AI model endpoints or chat streams.
Enhance the `rateLimit` utility to allow for dynamically configuring limits and windows based on the requested resource.
